# Fixture sources

Fetched data was downloaded into isolated directories and treated as untrusted; it is only ever parsed as data.

| Path | Origin | License | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| commonmark/spec.json | https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json (the `/current/` URL returned 404 at fetch time, so the version is pinned) | CC-BY-SA 4.0 (c) John MacFarlane | fetched, unmodified |
| gfm/tables.md, tasklist.md, strikethrough.md, autolink.md | Examples extracted from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/cmark-gfm/master/test/spec.txt (GFM spec 0.29) by script, joined with `<!-- example -->` separators | CC-BY-SA 4.0 (c) GitHub, Inc. / John MacFarlane | fetched, extracted |
| github/* | Small hand-written examples following GitHub docs behavior | BSD-2-Clause (this project) | original |
| gitlab/* | Hand-written examples based on the GitLab Flavored Markdown docs (docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/markdown.html); no text copied | BSD-2-Clause (this project) | original |
| obsidian/* | Hand-written examples based on Obsidian help docs syntax; no text copied | BSD-2-Clause (this project) | original |
| pandoc/* | Hand-written examples of pandoc / MultiMarkdown syntax | BSD-2-Clause (this project) | original |
| edge/* | Hand-written or generated (huge.md, deep-nesting.md generated by script) | BSD-2-Clause (this project) | original |
